content:
Apple TV's fall blockbuster lineup kicks off this week with the premiere of Ryan Reynolds' new film 《Mayday》, which is half buddy comedy and half action spy thriller. The first reviews are calling it a big winner.

Mayday reviews praise the action, humor, and chemistry between the two leads

Apple TV is best known for its series, with standout hits like 《Ted Lasso》, sci-fi epic 《Dark Matter》, and 《Silo》 currently streaming. But Apple TV's movies are also gaining more attention.

In addition to 15 new free classic films for subscribers, Apple has several high-profile original movies premiering soon, with 《Mayday》 leading the charge.

《Mayday》 premieres this Friday (September 4) on Apple TV (watch here).

The film stars Ryan Reynolds and Kenneth Branagh, directed by John Francis Daley and Jonathan Goldstein. This duo previously collaborated on 《Game Night》, 《Dungeons & Dragons: Honor Among Thieves》, and co-wrote 《Horrible Bosses》.

Reviews for 《Mayday》 have just dropped, and they're overwhelmingly positive. Here are some excerpts:

  • JoBlo: "《Mayday》 is absolutely one of the best non-theatrical films of the year, and one of the best streaming exclusives I can remember."
  • Empire: "When you hear 'Ryan Reynolds buddy comedy action movie' you kind of know what to expect—some slick fights, endless quippy dialogue, and a fairly entertaining time. 《Mayday》 delivers, with a few extra surprises thrown in."
  • The Hollywood Reporter: "This popcorn movie proves to be a thoroughly entertaining diversion, thanks to the mismatched buddy comedy chemistry between its two leads. It leaves you wanting the sequel it hints at."

Many reviews noted that 《Mayday》 feels like—and arguably should have been—a theatrical release.

Competently executed action, appealing humor, and Reynolds' leading performance combine to make the kind of film that could have been a summer blockbuster in years past.

Either way, Apple TV subscribers can stream it for free starting this week.

Apple TV costs $14.99 per month, or save with a bundle through Apple One.
